The judicial fallout marks an accelerating dismantling of the former regime after protesters breached state television studios demanding the arrest of pro-government editors.

note: Serbian prosecutor general launches sweeping reviews into past judicial political repression.

before.story: US Data Center Backlash Ahead of Midterms
before.summary: Voter and municipal opposition to AI data centers has spread from Memphis to battleground states in Ohio and Illinois, forcing tech giants to offer increased community payouts. Rating agencies have warned of potential credit downgrades for municipal utilities as the infrastructure buildout becomes a contentious issue in the midterm elections.

after.story: Ten US States Vote on Halting Data Centers
after.summary: Backlash against the rapid buildout of energy-intensive AI infrastructure has escalated to statewide ballots, with voters across 10 U.S. states set to vote on election day whether to restrict or curb local data center developments. The legislative push spreads beyond grassroots disputes in Ohio, Illinois, and Memphis, where utility credit downgrades and grid strains have made AI power consumption a defining midterm battleground issue.

note: Voters in 10 US states prepare ballot measures curbing data center development.
